hook.name: HookrRoot
hook.description: Modular Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic LP fees, pluggable Rules and Advisory modules, and an optional arb-recapture lane in which a frozen trusted executor runs sandwiched swaps around each user trade to capture arbitrage profit for LPs. Pools opt into the recapture lane at initialization; every other pool follows a standard or fee-only path with optional dynamic fee simulation.
